text:
GENERATE BURST KS-Y-SE — Run C-9 P4, fill the SE slot (Matt R-C9-22). task_id "KS-Y-SE".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1: a 1536x1024 sheet of 4 equal vertical slots. Slots 1-3 hold the same knight facing away (north), away to the upper-right (north-east) and screen-right (east) — KEEP SLOTS 1-3 EXACTLY AS THEY ARE. Slot 4 (rightmost) is flat green: paint the SAME knight there, on the same baseline and at the same height, facing the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT at a clear 45 degrees (south-east): turned halfway between his east view (slot 3) and facing the viewer; we see his chest and tabard front at an angle.
He must be IDENTICAL to slots 1-3: the same helm (rounded skull with red-brown hatching; a smooth rounded visor with one row of small holes), the same knee wings and hinged knee plates, the same blue tabard with gold cross-crosslets and gold diagonal bands, short open side flaps and red lining; the POLLAXE in his ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand — in this view his right hand is on the SCREEN-LEFT side of his body, nearest the camera — upright, butt on the ground; rest stance, both feet planted. NO MIRRORING. Same camera and light as slots 1-3; same painted hand. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 1: do not restyle anything. Every pixel outside the figures stays flat pure #00ff00.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if slots 1-3 changed, he does not face the lower-right, the pollaxe is in his left hand, the helm/knees/tabard differ from slots 1-3, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KS-Y-SE_a.png and out/KS-Y-SE_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KS-Y-SE"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE SHEET TO EDIT (keep slots 1-3; paint slot 4 = SE)
